Private 1.7 Acre Building lot Retreat
Discover a rare opportunity to create your own private country retreat on 1.7 acres surrounded by towering pines and hardwoods. Tucked away on a quiet dead-end road, this peaceful property offers a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion while still providing the convenience of electric already in place and its own private driveway.
The natural setting creates an inviting escape for weekends with friends and family, whether you envision a cozy cabin, camper, or future country home. There is plenty of room to relax, explore, gather around a campfire, and enjoy the quiet of the outdoors.
If you’ve been looking for a place to get away from it all and create something of your own, this secluded property offers the privacy, natural beauty, and flexibility to make that vision a reality.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: GMO’s and Timber Convey. 4.4 miles to Cuba, 8.7 miles to Olean, 9.5 miles to Portville. Priced well to sell!
